text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What a massive haul! You did great!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This should be more than enough!
Thanks a ton,
Teach!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' much. Seeing you flaunt your
skills has
got me itchin' for a little
competition!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Let's see who can get the most prizes!
You in?!
